ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can flag an engine fault early, but a mechanic still has to open the panel and confirm which component actually failed.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 139,400 aircraft mechanics and service technicians employed in 2024, rising to a projected 145,000 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 5,600 jobs and about 11,300 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $78,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace aircraft mechanics, but it will change maintenance methods. AI is taking over desk-based tasks such as condition monitoring, fault prediction, and inspection data analysis. Mechanics are shifting from finding faults mainly through experience to confirming AI alerts and performing manual-based repairs. On-site removal, installation, judgment, and return-to-service responsibility remain irreplaceable. Safety regulations require a person who signs off to accept responsibility.
ai_s2_accel: Early alerts from engine condition monitoring and fault prediction
AI-assisted borescope imaging identifies component wear
Intelligent maintenance manual search delivers relevant work cards by fault
Pilot programs use drones and robots for inspections
ai_s2_auto: Digital maintenance records and work cards with automatic archiving of signature trails
Automated reminders and scheduling for routine inspections
Automated component inventory and service-life tracking
Automatic synchronization of maintenance data and airworthiness directives
ai_s3_list: On-site removal, installation, and procedural work: replacing parts, applying torque, and assembling components require physical effort and skilled hands.
On-site diagnosis of difficult faults: a system can suggest a direction, but a mechanic must verify whether it is correct.
Return-to-service responsibility: a signature means the mechanic accepts responsibility for the aircraft. AI cannot carry that accountability.
Communication with operations teams: people must clearly explain faults that affect release to dispatchers and flight crews.
Regulatory and airworthiness judgment: people apply regulations when nonstandard situations fall outside the manual.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means documentation and monitoring tasks in this career are being automated. Systems increasingly handle records, scheduling, and component tracking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. More precise monitoring makes confirmation and response skills even more important, along with on-site mechanical work and return-to-service responsibility. Automation pressures low-skill tasks performed without data literacy, while licensed technicians with combined skills become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study civil aviation maintenance, aircraft maintenance, or mechatronics and plan your licensing path. CAAC/FAA licenses are firm requirements. Build theory knowledge and practical hours from the start, then enter an airline or MRO after graduation.

Master condition monitoring systems, maintenance data, and fault prediction tools. Volunteer for aircraft systems data analysis. Advance from mechanical work to understanding systems and making sound judgments. Return-to-service authorization is a major income threshold.

Career changers with mechanical or mechatronics backgrounds should study civil aviation maintenance theory and earn a license before entering through an MRO or general aviation fleet. On your resume, specify faults you resolved, licenses you hold, and aircraft releases you completed.

Do not hire maintenance technicians based only on years of licensure. Evaluate system proficiency and troubleshooting logic. Younger technicians who use AI monitoring tools and locate faults quickly are stronger development candidates than veterans who follow manuals slowly without effective diagnosis.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Work card scheduling, digital records, and signature trails
Real-time data monitoring and early fault warnings
Internal wear detection and trend analysis
Find work cards from fault reports and link relevant drawings
Three-stage tool counts and controlled work areas
Service-life monitoring, inventory, and airworthiness tracking
Historical fault database and root cause analysis
Access work cards on site, document work with photos, and report immediately

ai_s7_trends: Condition monitoring and fault prediction are becoming standard maintenance tools. Maintenance is shifting from scheduled teardown inspections to condition-based work, with mechanics making data-supported decisions.
The shortage of maintenance talent continues. Licensed technicians who understand systems command a clear premium, while demand declines for purely physical removal and installation roles.
Drones and robotic inspection tools are entering practical use, but licensed mechanics continue to carry return-to-service responsibility.

body: Aircraft Mechanics And Service Technicians perform routine maintenance, diagnose faults, replace components, and release civil aircraft after maintenance. They verify aircraft safety under regulations and work cards and hold licensed core technical roles in aviation maintenance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能提前报出发动机故障，但拆开盖板确认「就是这个部件坏了」的那双手，还得是机械师的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年飞机机械师技术员在岗约 13.94 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.50 万人，净增约 0.56 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.87 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代飞机机械师，但会改变检修方式。状态监测、故障预测、检测数据分析这些桌面活正被 AI 接管，机械师从「凭经验找故障」转向「确认 AI 提示、执行手册化维修」。真正不可替代的是现场的拆装、判断和放行责任——安全规章决定了一个人签字，就必须由人来承担。
ai_s2_accel: 发动机状态监测与故障预测提前告警
AI 辅助孔探/图像识别判断部件磨损
维修手册智能检索，按故障直接给工卡
无人机与机器人进入检查场景试点
ai_s2_auto: 维修记录与工卡电子化，签署留痕自动归档
例行检查项由系统自动提醒与排程
部件库存与寿命跟踪自动化管理
维修数据与适航指令自动同步
ai_s3_list: 现场拆装与工艺执行：换件、打力矩、装配，每步都是体力加手艺。
疑难故障的临场诊断：系统提示了方向，但「是不是它」要靠现场验证。
放行责任的承担：签字意味着「我对这架飞机负责」，这份责任 AI 扛不了。
与运行团队的沟通：故障影响放行时，怎么跟调度、机组讲清楚，靠人。
规章与适航判断：手册之外的非标情况，怎么处置按规章由人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的文档与监测类工作正被自动化——记录、排程、部件跟踪都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为监测更精准，机械师被要求「更会确认、更会处置」，现场拆装和放行责任反而更重要。真正被挤压的是不会用数据、只靠蛮力的低技能环节，持照的复合型机务更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选民航维修、飞行器维修或机电一体化专业，规划好考照路径。CAAC/FAA 执照是硬门槛，从入学就攒理论和实作工时，毕业直接进航司或 MRO。
把状态监测系统、维修数据和故障预测工具用熟，主动接飞机系统数据分析的活。从「会拆装」升级为「懂系统、能判断」，放行资格是收入分水岭。
有机械或机电背景的转行者，先补民航维修理论再考执照，从 MRO 或通航机队切入。简历上多写「排除过哪些典型故障、持有哪类执照、放行多少架次」。
招机务别只看执照年限，要看系统使用能力和排故思路。会用 AI 监测工具、能快速定位故障的年轻技师，比只会按手册磨洋工的老人更值得培养。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 工卡排程、记录电子化、签署留痕
实时数据监测、故障提前预警
内部磨损识别、趋势分析
按故障反查工卡、关联图纸
寿命监控、库存与适航跟踪
现场查工卡、拍照留痕、即时上报

ai_s7_trends: 状态监测与故障预测成为机务标配，维修从「定期拆检」转向「按状态维修」，机械师变成数据辅助下的决策者。
维修人才缺口持续，持照、懂系统的复合型机务溢价明显，纯体力拆装岗需求下降。
无人机与机器人辅助检查进入实用阶段，但放行责任始终由持照机械师承担。

body: 飞机机械师技术员负责民用飞机的日常维护、故障诊断、部件更换与维修放行工作，依据规章和工卡对飞机安全状态进行确认，是航空维修体系中持证上岗的核心技术岗位。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate scores and materials, but the teacher still decides which passage needs slower practice, which movement needs correction, and how to communicate artistic feeling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows that about 122,800 postsecondary teachers in this category were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 124,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,000 jobs, with roughly 9,000 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $80,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary art teachers, but it will change lesson preparation. AI can draft musical examples, materials, and lesson plans, moving teachers away from writing lecture notes toward live demonstration, correcting technique, offering aesthetic critique, and guiding students to produce work. Instructors who only read slides face the greatest pressure, while those with strong demonstration skills and access to performance resources become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Personalized practice recommendations
Student proficiency profiles
Assistance with performance and exhibition planning
Teaching and research literature search
ai_s2_auto: Automated courseware generation
Score and material generation
Batch preliminary screening of assignments
Automatic annotation of performance recordings
ai_s3_list: Live demonstration: people must guide the movement.
Aesthetic critique: people must explain the feeling.
Corrective instruction: people must address the details.
Work review: people must set the quality standard.
Teacher-student interaction: people must build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure zone for teaching. Lesson preparation is accelerated, but live instruction still requires people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Repetitive tasks such as reading lecture notes and grading assignments are being automated, not the role of demonstrating techniques and guiding students in person. Teachers who can demonstrate and deliver strong performance or exhibition outcomes become scarcer as productivity improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you pursue the professional track, start developing both technique and communication skills early. Reading from a script is losing value in the AI era, so build a record of performances and teaching work.
Move beyond explaining the textbook to demonstrating techniques and guiding student work. Build a record of performance, exhibition, teaching, and research outcomes.
Emphasize your professional background and teaching results, and include student work and performance records.
Do not hire based on credentials alone. Look at whether the candidate can demonstrate techniques and guide students to produce strong work.

ai_s7_trends: Digital performance and exhibition formats are growing.
Cross-media creation is receiving greater attention.
Online art courses are reaching wider audiences.

body: Postsecondary art, drama, and music teachers teach visual art, theater, or music courses, design lessons, organize rehearsals and performances, and contribute to educational research and evaluation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能出谱面、做素材，但哪段要慢练、哪个动作要纠、怎么把感觉讲出来，还是老师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教师、高等教育在岗约 12.28 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 12.48 万人，净增约 0.20 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.90 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.02 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校艺术教师，但会改备课方式。AI 能生成谱例、素材与教案草稿，教师从「写讲义」挪向「现场示范、动作纠偏、审美点评、带学生出作品」。真正被挤掉的是只念 PPT 的，有示范力和展演资源的人更值钱。

学生水平画像
展演方案辅助
教研文献检索
ai_s2_auto: 课件自动生成
谱面与素材生成
作业批量初筛
演出录像自动标注
ai_s3_list: 现场示范：动作靠人带。
审美点评：感觉靠人讲。
纠偏指导：细节靠人纠。
作品把关：质量靠人定。
师生互动：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的教学区——备课被加速，但现场教学仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「念讲义、批作业」的重复动作，不是「现场示范带学生」的岗位。有示范力、能出展演成果的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走专业路线要早练技法也早练表达，AI 时代纯念稿在缩，多攒展演与教学作品。
从「讲课本」升级成「做示范 + 带作品」，攒展演与教研产出。
突出专业背景与带课成果，附学生作品与演出记录。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会示范、带不出作品。

ai_s7_trends: 展演数字化升温。
跨媒介创作受重视。
在线艺术课扩圈。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can count cells and read sequences in seconds, but biologists still decide which hypotheses are worth testing and which field samples to collect.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 63,700 biologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 64,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with approximately 4,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $93,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace biologists, but it will accelerate analysis and counting. Sequencing, image recognition, and statistical models speed up data processing, shifting biologists from counting toward forming hypotheses, designing experiments, making judgments, and writing insights. Entry-level workers limited to manual counting face displacement, while people with design and interdisciplinary skills become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Faster statistical modeling
Protein-structure prediction
Experimental-plan recommendations
Data visualization
ai_s2_auto: Automated image counting and recognition
Automated alignment of sequencing data
Structured experimental records
Automated literature classification
ai_s3_list: Forming hypotheses: depends on people.
Designing experiments: depends on sound design.
Field judgment: depends on experience.
Scientific intuition: depends on deep inquiry.
Writing insights: depends on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, places this occupation in an experimental zone of substantial exposure. AI assists with counting and analysis, while experimental design and judgment still leave a central role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Substantial exposure does mean change: AI accelerates image counting and sequence analysis, not the entire occupation of experimental design and scientific judgment. Biologists who combine data skills with the ability to form hypotheses become more secure. Entry-level workers limited to manual counting face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through a biology bachelor's degree and study more statistics and programming while at university. Pure counting roles are shrinking in the AI era, so develop data skills early.
Advance from running experiments to designing experiments and analyzing data. Learn modeling tools and work toward an independent research direction.
Emphasize your research direction and interdisciplinary skills, and clearly list your publications. Employers value consistent output.
Do not select candidates only for laboratory familiarity; assess whether they can ask good questions. Researchers who can design studies deserve resources.

ai_s7_trends: AI analysis becomes widespread, reducing counting work.
Biopharmaceuticals and synthetic biology are expanding.
Biologists who understand data and can design studies are in greater demand.

body: Biologists study organisms' structure, function, genetics, and ecological relationships. They design experiments and field surveys, use molecular, imaging, and statistical techniques to analyze data, and write papers supporting applications in medicine, agriculture, and environmental protection.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can count cells and read sequences in seconds, but biologists still decide which hypotheses are worth testing and which field samples to collect.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒数细胞、秒读序列，但哪个假设值得验、田野里哪片样该取，还是生物学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年生物学家在岗约 6.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.45 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物学家，但会加速分析与计数。测序、图像识别与统计模型把数据处理提速，生物学家从「数数」挪向「提假设、设实验、做判断、写洞见」。真正被挤掉的是只做手工计数的初级工，有设计与交叉力的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 统计建模加速
蛋白结构预测
实验方案推荐
数据可视化
ai_s2_auto: 图像自动计数识别
测序数据自动比对
实验记录结构化
文献自动归类
ai_s3_list: 提假设：靠人。
设实验：靠设计。
田野判断：靠经验。
科学直觉：靠钻。
写洞见：靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的实验区——计数分析被辅助，但设计与判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：被加速的是「图像计数与序列分析」动作，不是「实验设计与科学判断」的岗位。有交叉数据力、能提假设的生物学家，反而更稳。怕的是只做手工计数的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 生物本科打底，在校多学统计与编程。AI 时代纯计数在缩，早点练数据。
从「跑实验」升级成「设实验 + 析数据」，学建模工具，争取独立方向。
突出方向与交叉技能，写清发过哪些论文。单位看重稳和产出。
选人别只看实验熟，要看会不会提问题。能设计的研究员，值得给资源。

ai_s7_trends: AI 分析普及，计数缩。
生物医药与合成生物热。
会数据能设计的生物学家更抢手。

body: 生物学家研究生物体的结构、功能、遗传与生态关系，设计实验与野外调查，运用分子、成像与统计技术分析数据，并撰写论文支持医药、农业与环保应用。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒数细胞、秒读序列，但哪个假设值得验、田野里哪片样该取，还是生物学家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize cabinet drawings and cutting layouts quickly and efficiently, but machines cannot learn the feel required to make drawers glide smoothly and door gaps line up evenly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 86,000 Cabinetmakers And Bench Carpenters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 84,700 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,300 jobs, with approximately 8,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $46,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cabinetmakers And Bench Carpenters. The core work involves hand assembly, sanding, and on-site judgment, and robots and AI remain far less cost-effective than people for flexible, custom cabinetry. AI helps with design modeling, cutting layouts, and CNC equipment operation by automating repetitive manufacturing steps, but woodworking skill is what ultimately makes a cabinet attractive and practical.
ai_s2_accel: AI-generated custom design proposals
CNC edge-banding and drilling automation
Automated nesting of panel offcuts
Digital order and production scheduling
ai_s2_auto: Software-based cabinet design and modeling
Automated cutting-layout optimization
Automated panel cutting with CNC machines
Automatically generated hardware lists
ai_s3_list: Assembly feel: even door gaps and smooth drawers.
Sanding skill: tactile wood-surface finishing and edge beveling.
On-site judgment: identify color variation and warping in panels.
Material planning: minimize waste without cutting errors.
Final quality control: verify a precise fit and finish.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places cabinetmaking among hands-on occupations with relatively low AI exposure. Software can take over data-driven, measurable design and cutting-layout tasks, but replacing physical assembly, sanding, and adjustment is extremely costly. The main risk is not replacement by AI but displacement of production-line jobs by CNC equipment. Woodworkers who handle custom work and solve problems on site are more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure is no reason to stand still. CNC cutting machines and design software are already standard equipment, and woodworkers who use them work faster and make fewer errors. Master CNC equipment and cut-list software, then invest the time saved in assembly craft and customer communication. Your value will keep rising in custom work.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A student with strong hands-on ability and the patience to stay focused can study furniture manufacturing or woodworking and earn an occupational skill certificate. The custom-furnishings industry lacks skilled workers. A capable woodworker can earn as much as an office professional, and experience increases the value of the craft.

Move toward custom furniture. Learn to read custom drawings, prepare cut lists, and operate CNC cutting machines, then add on-site measuring and installation experience. A woodworker who independently handles a project from measurement through installation will have a steady stream of work in the renovation market.

With no prior experience, start as an apprentice in a furniture factory. Learn cutting and assembly first, then CNC equipment. Bring a small piece you made, such as a stool or shelf, to an interview. It demonstrates more than words can.

Skilled woodworkers are hard to recruit. Retain them with transparent piece rates plus skill-grade pay, and use CNC equipment to reduce physical strain. For versatile workers who can measure and install, project-based profit sharing is a more effective retention tool.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically break drawings into parts and generate material lists

ai_s6_tools.工具: Sliding table saw / electronic panel saw

ai_s7_trends: Whole-home customization is expanding, and custom cabinet orders continue to grow.
As CNC cutting and cut-list software become widespread, production-line woodworking jobs are shrinking.
Versatile woodworkers who can measure, design, and install are in greater demand.

body: Cabinetmakers And Bench Carpenters use woodworking machinery and hand tools to make cabinets, casework, and panel furniture from drawings and material lists. They cut materials, assemble parts, install hardware, sand, and finish surfaces while ensuring dimensional accuracy and visual quality.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明橱柜制造属于「低 AI 曝光」的手工型岗位：数据化、可量化的设计排料环节能被软件接管，但拼装、打磨、调试这些物理世界的手工活，AI 替代成本极高。风险不在被 AI 取代，而在流水线岗位被数控设备挤占——会做定制、能现场解决问题的木工更吃香。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于可以躺平：数控开料机和设计软件已经是标配，会用工具的木工效率高、出错少。把数控设备和拆单软件学熟，把省下的时间用在拼装手艺和客户沟通上，定制赛道里你会越做越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子动手能力强、坐得住板凳的，可以读家具制造或木工相关专业，考职业技能等级证书。定制家居行业缺熟练工，技术好的木工收入不比白领差，越老越吃香。
往定制家具方向走：学会看定制图纸、拆单和数控开料机操作，再补一点现场测量与安装经验；能独立从测量做到安装的木工，在装修圈子里单子接不完。
零基础进家具厂从学徒干起，先学开料和拼装，再学数控设备；面试时带一件自己做的小作品（小板凳、置物架），比说任何话都有说服力。
好木工难招，建议用「计件透明 + 技能等级工资」留人，同时配数控设备降低劳动强度；对能测量、能安装的复合型师傅，按项目分成绑住更划算。

ai_s7_trends: 全屋定制扩张，定制橱柜订单持续增长。
数控开料与拆单软件普及，流水线木工岗位收缩。
能测量、能设计、能安装的复合型木工更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 351,200 Cytotechnologists were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 357,200 by 2034. That represents about 6,000 net new jobs and roughly 22,600 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $61,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cytotechnologists, but it will change slide review. Digital imaging and initial-screening algorithms accelerate repetitive screening, shifting specialists from examining every field to reviewing abnormalities, interpreting difficult cases, and overseeing quality control. Routine initial screening is what gets faster; people with sound judgment and accountability become more valuable.

ai_s3_list: Difficult-case interpretation: people decide whether cells appear cancerous.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure: systems accelerate initial screening, while human judgment and accountability remain essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate AI exposure does not mean replacement. People with sharp eyes and sound accountability become scarcer as efficiency rises; those limited to mechanical slide scanning face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in medical laboratory science or a related field, and get extensive practice with microscopy and digital imaging in school. Pure initial screening is shrinking in the AI era, so develop interpretation and quality-control skills early.
Move from slide scanning to review + interpretation. Learn digital-imaging tools and work toward lead reviewer or quality-control responsibilities.
Emphasize credentials and actual slide-review volume, and state clearly which specimen types you have handled. Laboratories value consistency and attention to detail.
Do not hire only for speed; assess interpretation accuracy. A lead reviewer who can accept responsibility is worth stronger performance-based pay.

ai_s7_trends: Digital imaging raises efficiency and reduces initial screening work.
Early detection and precision medicine drive demand.
Lead reviewers who can interpret findings and accept responsibility become more sought after.

3D motor disassembly training tools
AI estimates linked to parts inventory
ai_s2_auto: Online lookup of parts models and specifications
Search fault codes and diagnostic knowledge bases
Digital repair records and service histories
Automated order scheduling and delivery reminders
ai_s3_list: Fault diagnosis: combine sound, sparks, and current readings.
Winding and assembly: manual workmanship directly affects equipment life.
Balancing and adjustment: precise rotor balancing and clearance settings.
On-site problem solving: temporary solutions for unusual equipment or missing parts.
Safety and standards: disciplined work around high voltage and rotating equipment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure range. The work produces repaired physical equipment. AI assists with information lookup and recordkeeping, while hands-on skill remains central and limits automation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean standing still. Technicians who use intelligent test tools and record repair data work more efficiently and justify estimates more convincingly. As equipment becomes smarter, technicians who can repair intelligent systems become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a student with strong practical ability and patience, a vocational electromechanical program offers a practical path. A bachelor's degree is not the only route. Skills gain value after several years of apprenticeship, but safety and occupational health deserve close attention.

Move toward advanced equipment such as variable-frequency drives, servo motors, and electric vehicle motors. Few technicians can repair them, so service rates are higher. Use test instruments well and combine experience with data.

People with electrical fundamentals or appliance repair experience can transition quickly. Start as an apprentice in a repair shop or factory equipment department and earn credentials while working. In interviews, emphasize equipment types and fault cases rather than education alone.

Strong technicians are hard to recruit and retain. Pay by technical grade + piece rate so better craft earns visibly higher income. Provide proper workstations, tools, and protective equipment. Respect keeps skilled repairers on the job.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Test winding insulation and dielectric strength

ai_s7_trends: Growth in automation and new-energy equipment increases repair demand.
Intelligent testing tools spread, raising the value of technicians who combine skill with data.
As younger workers leave the trade, senior technicians grow scarcer and service rates can rise.

body: Electric Motor, Power Tool, And Related Repairers diagnose, dismantle, repair, and test motors, generators, power tools, and similar electrical equipment. They replace coils, bearings, brushes, and other parts, then perform balancing, insulation, and operating tests.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can memorize the specifications of every motor, but only an ear trained by dismantling hundreds of machines can tell whether a strange sound comes from a bearing or a phase loss.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能背下所有电机的型号参数，但「这台电机的异响是轴承还是缺相」——这声音，只有拆过几百台机器的耳朵听得出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电机、电力工具在岗约 1.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.77 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代电机与电力工具修理工：这行的核心是拆装和检测，物理世界里的脏活、累活、精细活，机器人短期干不了也干不起。AI 能帮的是故障诊断知识库、配件型号查询和测试数据记录，但这些只是让师傅干活更快的工具，替代不了手和耳朵。
ai_s2_accel: 振动/电流传感器辅助诊断
绝缘测试数据自动记录分析
电机模型 3D 拆解教学工具
AI 报价与配件库存联动
ai_s2_auto: 配件型号与参数的在线查询
故障代码与知识库检索
维修记录与档案电子化
订单排期与交付提醒自动化
ai_s3_list: 故障诊断：听声、看火花、测电流综合判断。
绕线与装配：手工工艺直接影响设备寿命。
平衡与调试：转子动平衡、间隙调整的精度。
现场应变：异形设备、缺件时的临时方案。
安全与规范：高压、旋转设备的作业习惯。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这是典型的「中高曝光」手艺岗：工作对象是物理设备，输出是修好的实物，AI 能插手的只有资料查询和记录类事务，核心工艺全是手感，自动化空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于原地踏步：会用智能检测工具、能把维修数据记录下来的师傅，维修效率和报价说服力都更强；而且设备越来越智能，会修智能设备的师傅更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子动手能力强、坐得住，读职校机电专业是条实在路。别只盯着本科，这行学徒期几年后就是手艺越老越值钱，但要提醒孩子注意安全和职业卫生，别把身体熬垮了。
往高端设备走：变频器、伺服电机、新能源汽车电机，会修的人少、单价高。同时把检测工具用好，逐步从「凭经验」转向「经验+数据」。
有电工基础或修过家电的人转过来最快。先找家维修店或工厂设备部当学徒，边干边考证；面试时突出修过的设备类型和故障案例，比学历管用。
好师傅难招也难留，建议按「技术等级+计件」给钱，让手艺好的人明显多赚；同时配好工位、工具和劳保，修理工被尊重才留得住。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化与新能源设备保有量增长，维修需求只增不减。
智能检测工具普及，手艺与数据结合的师傅更值钱。
年轻人流失让高级技工稀缺，维修单价有望抬升。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can route wires, add annotations, and generate a BOM, but someone who understands electrical principles must still verify why a line follows its path and whether every symbol is correct.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 21,600 Electrical And Electronics Drafters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 20,400 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,200 jobs, with about 1,700 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $73,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is changing drafting at scale, but the drafter role will not disappear. Instead, it will move upstream. Automated layouts, annotations, and AI-generated drawings take over mechanical drafting. People retain responsibility for principles, reviews, standards, and construction coordination. Those are the capabilities drafters should develop.
ai_s2_accel: Generative design tools for comparing options
Automated AI compliance review of drawings
Broader use of collaborative 3D electrical design platforms
Intelligent recommendations from component and standards libraries
ai_s2_auto: Automated CAD routing and annotation
AI-assisted generation of electrical schematics
Automated BOM and terminal schedule preparation
Automated drawing version and layer management
ai_s3_list: Principles: understanding design logic produces correct drawings.
Standards control: keep frames, labels, and numbering consistent.
Drawing review: identify design gaps and conflicts.
Coordination: align with engineers and construction teams.
Integrated judgment: assess feasibility from drawing to site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderate-high AI exposure range. AI and CAD automation replace many drawing actions, while value shifts toward drawing review, standards management, and design assistance. Pure drafting carries high risk, but understanding principles places drafters at the entry point to design.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not eliminate career options. Automation replaces CAD operators, not people who understand electricity. Build strong knowledge of electrical principles and use AI as a productivity tool. Drafters can progress toward design assistant and electrical designer roles.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Avoid training that teaches only software operation. Electrical principles and design fundamentals matter more. Postsecondary vocational study in electrical or electromechanical systems + independent CAD/EPLAN study provides broader options than drafting alone.

Move early from drawing toward understanding principles. Learn design logic from engineers, study EPLAN and 3D electrical design, and take responsibility for reviews and standards management. As AI drawing improves, domain knowledge becomes more valuable.

Practical electrical experience provides an advantage because field knowledge makes drawings workable. Build strong CAD skills, earn a relevant electrical credential, and bring a complete drawing set to interviews.

Do not test only software proficiency when hiring drafters. Add an interview round that asks candidates to find drawing errors and explain principles. Create a design development path so skilled drafters can become designers instead of repeatedly hiring replacements.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Electrical drawing production and project management
Maintain component models and standards libraries

ai_s7_trends: AI-generated drawings and automated annotations become standard, sharply reducing pure drafting roles.
Drafters move toward design assistant and electrical designer roles, with a premium for understanding principles.
3D electrical design and collaboration platforms spread as 2D drafting becomes integrated with other formats.

body: Electrical And Electronics Drafters use CAD and related tools to create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control cabinet layouts, and electronic circuit drawings. They convert engineering designs into standard documents for construction and manufacturing.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can route wires, add annotations, and generate a BOM, but someone who understands electrical principles must still verify why a line follows its path and whether every symbol is correct.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电气与电子制图员在岗约 2.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.04 万人，岗位净减约 0.12 万个，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在大规模改变制图工作，但不会让「制图员」这个角色消失，而是把它往上推：自动布图、自动标注、AI 生成图纸会接管机械性画图，剩下的是理解原理、审图、管标准和对接施工的活——这恰恰是制图员该往前走的方向。
ai_s2_accel: 生成式设计工具辅助方案比选
图纸合规性 AI 自动审查
三维电气设计协同平台普及
元件库与标准库的智能化推荐
ai_s2_auto: CAD 自动布线与自动标注
电气原理图的 AI 辅助生成

ai_s3_list: 原理理解：看得懂设计逻辑才能画得对。
规范把控：图框、标注、编号的标准一致。
审图纠错：发现设计里的漏洞和冲突。
沟通协调：跟工程师、施工方对得上。
综合判断：从图纸到现场的可行性问题。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的「画图动作」正在被 AI 和 CAD 自动化大量替代，但制图员的价值会转移到「审图、管标准、辅助设计」——纯画图的人风险高，懂原理的人反而站在了设计入口。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没出路：被替代的是「CAD 操作员」，不是「懂电气的人」。把电气原理学扎实，把 AI 工具当效率助手，制图员转型设计助理甚至电气设计师的路是通的。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 别把孩子送到「只会教软件操作」的培训班，重点学电气原理和设计基础。大专电气、机电专业 + 自学 CAD/EPLAN，就业面比纯制图宽得多。
趁早从「画图」往「懂原理」走：跟着工程师学设计逻辑，学 EPLAN、三维电气设计，主动承担审图和标准管理。AI 出图越强，懂行的人越值钱。
有电工实操经验的人转制图有优势，现场经验让图纸更接地气。把 CAD 练熟、考个电气相关证书，面试时带上你画的成套图纸案例。
制图岗位招聘别只测软件熟练度，加一轮「看图找错、讲清原理」的面试；给制图员开设计培养通道，把会画图的人往设计师带，比反复招新人划算。

三维电气设计与协同平台普及，二维制图走向融合。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 15,000 Electro Mechanical And Mechatronics Technologists And Technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 15,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 100 jobs, with about 1,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $70,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Electro Mechanical And Mechatronics Technologists And Technicians, but it will assist with fault diagnosis. Digital twins and predictive maintenance identify where failures are likely, shifting technicians from blind searches to precise repairs and hands-on replacement. Workers who only replace fuses without understanding control logic face pressure, while versatile technicians who understand PLCs and calibration become more valuable.

Knowledge-base assistance for interpreting fault codes
Visual detection of equipment leaks and abnormal sounds

ai_s2_auto: Early warnings for bearing and motor problems through predictive maintenance
Digital-twin identification of fault locations and affected areas
Automatic collection and reporting of equipment operating parameters

ai_s3_list: Hands-on disassembly and wiring: machines cannot reach into every control cabinet.
On-site servo calibration: people must test and adjust the system iteratively.
Cross-system judgment: troubleshooting spans mechanical, electrical, and software systems.
Emergency repairs: people must respond when production stops.
Collaboration with engineers: site experience feeds back into design.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-to-moderate exposure range for hands-on work. Systems can warn and locate faults, but people still perform disassembly and calibration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-to-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces blind searching and recordkeeping tasks, not hands-on repair roles. Technicians who understand control logic and can calibrate and troubleshoot equipment become scarcer as systems get smarter. The greater risk is staying limited to part replacement and never learning PLCs.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through an associate degree in electromechanical or automation technology, and get extensive practice with PLCs and variable-frequency drives while in school. Basic part replacement is shrinking in the AI era, so learn control logic early.
Move from replacing fuses to reading programs and calibrating servos. Learn industrial buses and digital twins, then work toward a Automation Engineer role.
Highlight PLC and troubleshooting experience. Specify which equipment you repaired and how much downtime you reduced. Factories value technicians who can become productive quickly.
Do not hire for physical strength alone; assess control-system knowledge. Technicians who can calibrate equipment independently merit skilled-worker pay.

ai_s7_trends: Predictive maintenance is becoming common, and systems are taking over some routine inspections.
Digital twins are shifting troubleshooting from blind searches to precise diagnosis.
Multi-skilled technicians who understand PLCs and industrial buses are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Exercise Trainers And Group Fitness Instructors, but it will shift where they create value. AI-generated plans, automated fitness analysis, and online guided classes are spreading. Trainers move from issuing plans toward coaching on site, correcting movement, tracking outcomes, and motivating clients. Training depends on consistency, and human supervision and companionship remain central.

AI movement recognition corrects form
Smart fitness mirrors and online personal training
Digital gym-operations platforms

Automated fitness-assessment analysis

Online guided classes replace some instruction
ai_s3_list: Movement-correction judgment: spot the error and injury risk immediately.
Client motivation: bring people back when they tire or want to quit.
On-site coaching presence: machines cannot create class energy or control pacing.
Rehabilitation and special-population knowledge: professional judgment determines safe exercise for injured clients.
Outcome tracking and adjustment: plans are static, but people change and require ongoing adaptation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. AI increasingly handles plan generation and data analysis, including plans, body-fat measurement, and recordkeeping.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes on plans and data, while people lead sessions and motivate clients. Trainers who only issue plans face pressure. Trainers who coach well, understand rehabilitation, and retain clients become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study physical education, athletic training, or rehabilitation and earn a respected credential. Build teaching ability and communication skills, not just your own physique.

An exercise background is useful. Earn a credential, start as a floor trainer, and show client count, renewal rate, and rehabilitation experience on your resume.

Growth in fitness participation and health awareness increases demand, especially in rehabilitation training and posture correction.
Online fitness and smart equipment divert some demand. Trainers are becoming hybrid professionals who combine in-person coaching + online accountability + data-backed outcomes.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代健身教练，但会改变价值重心。AI 生成训练计划、自动体测分析、线上跟练课越来越普遍，教练从「发计划」转向「现场带练、动作纠错、效果追踪、客户激励」。训练不是练动作，是练坚持——人的监督和陪伴，是 AI 替代不了的核心。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「方案和数据」环节，留下的是「带练和激励」环节。纯发计划的教练会被压缩，会带练、懂康复、能留住客户的教练反而更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize transport schedules and calculate linen inventory precisely, but orderlies are still needed to guide beds smoothly through doorways and support older patients after surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 54,000 orderlies were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 55,800, a net increase of about 1,800 jobs, with about 7,800 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $37,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace orderlies, but it will optimize their workflows. Systems can handle transport dispatch, scheduling, linen inventory, and equipment location tracking, saving time spent searching for supplies or waiting for assignments and allowing orderlies to focus on physical transport and care. What remains truly scarce is the steadiness and patience they show patients, qualities machines cannot provide.

ai_s3_list: Strength and technique: lifting, turning, and transferring patients require skills built through long practice.
Patient communication and reassurance: anxious patients need a person's tone and gestures.
Situational response: experience guides the immediate protection of patient safety during emergencies.
Careful observation: orderlies are often the first to notice that a patient's condition seems wrong.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that systems are optimizing scheduling and recordkeeping, while core transport and care combine physical work with interpersonal interaction and offer limited scope for automation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not mean no change. Smart equipment and robots will reduce some physical strain and standardize the role. The part being reduced is work that uses strength without judgment. People willing to learn care skills and advance into nursing assistant roles will have broader opportunities.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you start as an orderly, plan toward nursing. Earn care-related credentials, move from orderly to nursing assistant, then qualify as a nurse. Entry-level hospital work is a stepping stone, not the destination.

Build strong basic care and first-aid skills and actively pursue transfer opportunities. Hospital nursing, logistics management, and care training are all advancement paths. Do not remain in repetitive physical work.

Care-related credentials add direct value, as does experience in nursing homes or in-home care. Start through a hospital or reputable outsourcing company, then assess labor protections and compensation before deciding whether to stay.

High orderly turnover stems from pay and respect, not a lack of candidates. Stable performance incentives, training pathways, and transfer opportunities are more cost-effective than continually hiring new staff.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年护工在岗约 5.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.58 万人，净增约 0.18 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.78 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代护工，但会优化他们的工作流。转运调度、排班、床品库存、设备位置追踪都能交给系统，护工省下找东西、等安排的时间，把力气花在真正的搬运和照护上。真正稀缺的，是面对患者时那份稳当和耐心，机器给不了。

ai_s2_auto: 转运任务与排班的系统化调度

ai_s3_list: 体力与技巧：抬人、翻身、过床是长期练出来的巧劲。
患者沟通与安抚：紧张的患者需要的是人的语气和手势。
现场应变：突发状况下先保患者安全，靠的是经验。
细心观察：患者状态不对劲，往往是护工最先发现。
与医护的默契：什么时候搭手、怎么搭，磨合出来才顺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的调度和记录环节正被系统优化，但核心的搬运和照护是体力与人际的结合，自动化替代空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低风险不等于没变化：智能设备和机器人会减轻一部分体力，也让岗位更标准化。真正被压缩的是「只出力不动脑」的部分，愿意学护理技能、往护理助理升级的人路更宽。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果以护工为起点，就往护理方向规划：考取护理相关证书，从护工转护理助理再考护士资格。医院基层岗位是跳板，别把它当终点。
把基础照护和急救技能学好，主动争取转岗机会。医院护理、后勤管理和照护培训都是向上走的路径，别停在重复的体力劳动里。
护理相关证书能直接加分，有养老院、家政照护经验也可以。先通过医院或正规外包公司入职，确认劳动保障和待遇再决定去留。
护工流动率高的根子是待遇和尊重，而不是找不到人。给稳定绩效、培训通道和转岗机会，比不断招新人更划算。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Kiln temperatures can follow automated curves, but when the kiln opens, an experienced potter's eye still determines whether the glaze succeeded.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 41,700 manufacturing potters were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 44,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,600 jobs, with approximately 5,500 openings annually. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace manufacturing potters, but it will take over material mixing and kiln temperatures. Automated clay preparation and closed-loop kiln controls stabilize mass production, shifting potters from tending the fire toward throwing and trimming, judging glaze defects, and making specialty and artistic ceramics. Repetitive forming roles face displacement, while skilled hands and a trained eye for glaze become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Machine-vision assistance in detecting glaze-color defects
Rapid test firing with digitized formulations
Digital-twin simulation of firing energy use
Intelligent scheduling of orders and kiln loads

ai_s3_list: Throwing feel: human hands control the force on the wheel.
Judging glaze defects: human eyes detect color variation and crawling.
Trimming details: human hands keep vessels properly shaped.
Specialty and artistic ceramics: creativity is difficult to replace.
Controlling kiln effects: experience reads the color of the fire.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in a craft area with moderately high exposure. Systems take over material mixing and temperature control, but people retain throwing and glaze judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: tending fires and repetitive forming tasks are replaced, not roles requiring skilled hands and a trained eye for glaze. Steady-handed potters who can make specialty and artistic ceramics become scarcer as standardization grows. Those who only perform mechanical forming face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through secondary vocational study in ceramic technology, with extensive practice on wheels and kilns. Repetitive forming is shrinking in the AI era, so develop tactile control and glaze judgment early.
Advance from forming to kiln supervision + specialty and artistic ceramics. Learn formulations and defect diagnosis to move into process roles.
Highlight forming and glaze-inspection experience, specifying the vessel types and kiln styles you have handled. Factories value steady hands and experience.
Do not hire based only on strength; assess tactile skill and visual judgment. Workers who can independently supervise kilns deserve skilled-worker premiums.

Machine vision makes glaze inspection more automated.

That judgment grows from relationships and experience in the counseling room.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 483,500 substance abuse and behavioral disorder counselors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 564,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 81,100 jobs, with approximately 48,300 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $59,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will change how addiction counseling is delivered, but it will not replace counselors. AI can efficiently process screening questionnaires, medication records, documentation, and data analysis for relapse alerts. It can also provide some psychoeducation and emotional support. Yet addiction treatment centers on trust + clinical judgment. Whether clients will tell you the truth and whether their condition today will carry them through the week can only be addressed through a genuine counseling relationship. Machines cannot replace that.
ai_s2_accel: AI emotional support tools as a supplement between counseling sessions
Digital therapeutics to support cognitive behavioral training
Big-data alerts for populations at high risk of relapse
Telecounseling platforms that expand service reach

Automated organization of case notes and treatment documentation
Automated medication and follow-up reminders
Structured statistics on relapse risk data
ai_s3_list: Building trust: Helping clients disclose their true addiction history.
Clinical judgment: Recognizing concealment, deception, and warning signs of relapse.
Relational therapy: Working with transference and countertransference.
Crisis intervention: Responding in person to high-risk moments such as relapse and self-harm.
Ethics and boundaries: Protecting both yourself and the client.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means that AI is taking over much of the documentation and data work, while the occupation's core value rests in the counseling relationship and clinical judgment. These are precisely the areas where AI performs worst and where errors are least acceptable. Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Counselors will shift their focus from records and processes toward relationships and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium risk does not mean no change. Counselors who use AI screening and digital tools can reserve more time for truly valuable professional relationships. Those who treat AI only as an adversary and refuse to learn will fall behind the growing range of automated tools.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is a long-term career. Consider undergraduate and graduate study in psychology or social work, enter rehabilitation settings for internships early, and receive structured supervision. Make motivational interviewing and relapse prevention your core skills, while prioritizing self-care. The emotional demands of this field are greater than most people expect.

Use AI screening, digital therapeutics, and telecounseling to reduce documentation burdens and preserve time for clients. Continue receiving supervision, watch for burnout, and work toward becoming an addiction counseling supervisor or program manager.

Begin in counseling support, social work at a rehabilitation organization, or hotline support. Earn relevant counseling credentials before moving into professional counseling. Before changing careers, volunteer to test whether you can tolerate the frustration of high relapse rates. Passion alone is not enough.

Do not use AI tools to cut professional staffing. Use them to reduce screening and documentation burdens. Counselors need adequate supervision, reasonable caseloads, and mental health support resources to remain in their roles and preserve service quality.

把 AI 筛查、数字疗法和远程咨询用起来，减轻文书负担，把时间留给个案。持续接受督导，警惕职业倦怠，往成瘾领域督导师或项目主管发展。

别用 AI 工具压缩专业编制，而是用它减轻文书和筛查负担。给咨询师充足的督导、合理的个案量与心理支持资源，才能留得住人、保得住服务质量。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Fully automated operation systems can drive trains more precisely than people, but an operator must still decide what to do when a door traps someone, a passenger faints, or an object appears on the track. These nonstandard situations require a person on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 9,600 operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 9,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 300 jobs, with about 900 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $84,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and fully automated operation will not make subway operators disappear overnight, but they are changing the role. Systems take over driving while operators shift toward monitoring and emergency coverage. Pure driving roles without signal knowledge or incident-response skills will gradually shrink.
ai_s2_accel: Greater signal-system automation

ai_s2_auto: Fully automated operation systems provide automatic train operation

ai_s3_list: Incident response: quickly assess and respond to signal failures, door abnormalities, or a passenger fainting.
Safety judgment: door confirmation and track observation are safety redundancies that must never be omitted.
Responding to nonstandard situations: people handle large crowds, severe weather, and temporary rerouting that systems cannot plan for.
Passenger communication: a reassuring word from an operator matters during onboard conflicts or when pregnant passengers, older adults, or lost riders need help.
Emergency coordination: effective cooperation with dispatchers, station staff, and police depends on long-term training.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means fully automated systems are taking over driving operations, while monitoring, emergency response, and incident handling are becoming more important. The occupation is transforming rather than disappearing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Fully automated operation develops gradually, first automating driving and then monitoring. Operators must provide an extra layer beyond the system: systems handle standard situations, while people handle nonstandard ones. Learning signals, fault response, and emergency command during the transition creates greater stability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you want to enter rail transit, study rail transportation or vehicle technology and ensure you meet physical requirements. In the AI era, do not focus only on driving. Learn signaling, communications, and emergency response because future operators combine monitoring with emergency duties.

Actively participate in signal, fault-response, and emergency training, advancing from knowing how to drive to knowing how to respond. Watch for internal dispatcher, instructor, and operations management roles and transition early as full automation changes the occupation.

Formal recruitment by metro operators is the standard entry route, and applicants must meet education and physical requirements. After entry, aim to develop both train-operation and emergency-response skills rather than remaining a pure driver. Also consider monitoring roles in other transportation operations.

When hiring for fully automated lines, focus on emergency judgment and response rather than driving ability alone. Provide current operators with signal and emergency transition training so automation-related anxiety becomes an opportunity for career development.

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入轨道交通，选轨道交通运输或车辆相关专业，身体条件要达标。AI 时代别只盯着「开车」，把信号、通信、应急处置学起来——未来的司机是「监控加应急」复合岗。
